title_sq: GODINE MULTIFUNKSIONALE NE SHITJE PRANE TEG!
description_sq:
GODINE MULTIFUNKSIONALE NE SHITJE PRANE TEG!
Objekti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me luksoze te Tiranes, ne Mjull Bathore, prane rrethrrotullimit te TEG. Mund te shfrytezohet si biznes Restorant-Hotel, por ekziston edhe mundesia per konvertim ne vile rezidenciale. Ka nje hapesire trualli prej 1700m2 dhe hapesire totale godine prej 1240 m2. Godina ka 4 kate dhe eshte e ndare:
*Kati nendhe me siperfaqe prej 260m2 , i cili ka hapesire parkingu per 5 automjete; 2 magazina te ndara; lavanderia; pusi dhe depozitat e ujit
*Kati i pare i cili ka sallen e restorantit me siperfaqe prej 380m2 dhe kapacitet per 120 persona; kuzhina me siperfaqe prej 60m2, e cila eshte e kompletuar dhe funksionale dhe 2 tualete ne funksion te restorantit. Ne pjesen e perparme eshte veranda me nje siperfaqe prej 150m2
*Kati i dyte me siperfaqe prej 260m2 qe eshte i ndare ne 2 mini salla vip ne funksion te restorantit, te cilat mund te konvertohen ne 2 dhoma hoteli; 4 dhoma hoteli dhe 1 lavanderi
*Kati i trete me siperfaqe 260m2 qe eshte i ndare ne nje salle restoranti me siperfaqe 100m2, e cila eshte e konvertueshme ne 3 dhoma hoteli; nje holl; 2 dhoma hoteli te kompletuara, nje tualet dhe nje zyre
Ne pjesen e pasme te godines ndodhet parkingu me nje hapesire per 14 automjete
Prona zoteron nje oborr te bollshem, ku ekziston mundesia per ndertimin e nje pishine. Zoteron nje gjenerator elektrik te kapacitetit te larte, pus uji dhe depozita per magazinimin e ujit, sistem gazi dhe sistem kondicionimi ne te gjitha hapesirat e brendshme
Eshte mundesi shume e mire investimi, per shkak te cmimit te larte te qirave qe mundeson zona dhe tipologjia e godines
Prona gezon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor
Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone mos nguroni te kontaktoni!
title_en: MULTIFUNCTIONAL BUILDING FOR SALE NEAR TEG!
description_en: MULTIFUNCTIONAL BUILDING FOR SALE NEAR TEG! The facility is located in one of the most luxurious areas of Tirana, in Mjull Bathore, near the TEG roundabout. It can be used as a Restaurant-Hotel business, but there is also the possibility of conversion into a residential villa. It has a land area of ​​1700 m2 and a total building area of ​​1240 m2. The building has 4 floors and is divided into: * Ground floor with a surface of 260m2, which has parking space for 5 vehicles; 2 separate warehouses; laundry; well and water deposits *The first floor which has the restaurant hall with a surface of 380m2 and capacity for 120 people; kitchen with a surface of 60m2, which is complete and functional and 2 toilets in the function of the restaurant. In the front part there is a veranda with an area of ​​150m2 *The second floor with an area of ​​260m2 which is divided into 2 mini VIP rooms for the function of the restaurant, which can be converted into 2 hotel rooms; 4 hotel rooms and 1 laundry *Third floor with an area of ​​260m2 which is divided into a restaurant hall with an area of ​​100m2, which is convertible into 3 hotel rooms; a lobby; 2 complete hotel rooms, a toilet and an office. At the back of the building there is a parking lot with a space for 14 vehicles. The property has a spacious yard, where there is the possibility of building a swimming pool. It has a high-capacity electric generator, water well and water storage tanks, gas system and air conditioning system in all internal spaces. It is a very good investment opportunity, due to the high rental price that the area and the typology of the building make possible. The property has full mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
